scope: Generic expiring acquired graveyard activation with printed mana-symbol cost and copiable white/Zombie/no-mana-cost token recipe. No ordinary DFT behavior or admission changes.

oracle.name: Cursecloth Wrappings
oracle.oracle_text:
Zombies you control get +1/+1.
{T}: Target creature card in your graveyard gains embalm until end of turn. The embalm cost is equal to its mana cost. (Exile that card and pay its embalm cost: Create a token that's a copy of it, except it's a white Zombie in addition to its other types and has no mana cost. Embalm only as a sorcery.)

primary_rules.use: Graveyard sorcery activation; absent mana cost is unpayable; replacement-modified cost is paid; noncast token X is zero; copiable white/type/no-cost exceptions and subsequent as-entry copy ordering.
Cursecloth Wrappings: printed characteristics copied; white replaces colors; Zombie is additional; no mana cost; copied entry behavior remains.

interfaces: Card::activation_cost_options and activation_x_symbols unify authored static costs with immutable printed-cost activation metadata

activation_slots.invariants: Central constants, compile-time strict ordering, authored activation-table length guard. Retain associated Card constants/helpers as aliases at integration.

semantics: Each successful grant creates a distinct exact-incarnation acquisition until cleanup. The ability outlives the grantor, is owned by the graveyard card, counts for no-abilities and craft predicates, is visible to graveyard ability borrowers, and is not copied onto the token.

Normal activation announcement, target-free payment, source-exile cost, stack, countering, cost modifiers, projected funding and owned rollback are reused. The printed source definition remains captured after paid exile.

The native printed mana notation metadata supplies numeric, WUBRGC, X, hybrid and twobrid costs without consulting alternate spell costs or Oracle English. Empty mana cost is unpayable; {0} is payable. Ordinary activations retain allocation-free static cost traversal.

Any positive X paid in the activation is independent of the noncast created token: its entry X and mana value are zero. Existing counter/as-entry/token-creation replacements see the complete modified recipe.

White replaces the source colors; Zombie adds to existing creature types; the copied card has no mana cost and mana value zero. Those properties are themselves copiable and frozen in actual/projected queries. Entry-turn power-up reductions consult the effective copied mana cost, so an embalmed Aerial Doombot still pays {5}{U}.

A later as-entry copy replacement replaces these initial layer-one exceptions. Decline retains them; choosing an already embalmed donor copies them. Temporary later copies restore the actual preceding recipe rather than reconstructing initial Embalm properties.

Exact graveyard source departure removes the acquisition. Exile prohibition prevents payment; a replacement that prevents the exile event still pays the modified cost without removing the unchanged graveyard acquisition.

pinned_cost_inventory.limit: No S or P occurs in any pinned creature mana cost. The native notation utility fails closed for unsupported future symbols; no executable Oracle parser was added.

color_CDA_audit.result: No creature rules body defines its own colors or has devoid. No admitted color-defining creature ability requires suppression for this batch. Layer-five color-setting effects remain later than the white copy exception.

representation.cold_rows: One optional owned row vector, allocated only by grants; omitted observation field when absent. Existing copy recipe gains a boolean; type overlay gains a false-omitted Zombie flag. Root measures final layouts and throughput.

integration_receipt: Preserve the newer CharacteristicWorld::activation_power_up_costs refactor. Replace its native definition.cost()/power_up_mana_cost_alternatives reduction collection with self.recipe(object.card).power_up_mana_reductions(). The older Game::power_up_costs edit in this commit is superseded by that shared helper.

Preserve Card::GRANTED_TAP_MANA, Card::GRANTED_SACRIFICE_MANA and Card::intrinsic_mana_activation_index public fixture APIs as aliases to central activation_slots. Existing generic granted templates remain before the intrinsic fallback; Embalm is a separate index.

Root performs two mechanical CopyTypes full-literal compatibility fills (zombie:false) in existing MSH Absorbing Man and Taskmaster definitions; no behavior/admission/provenance edits belong to this engine commit.

Schema199 must reject active acquired rows, true Embalm recipes, Zombie copy-type overlay, and a paid reserved-index65526 stack activation even when source acquisition rows have already disappeared. Inherited omitted defaults preserve prior serialization.

validation.Cargo: Not run by author. Root owns guarded production check, all-target check and 17 focused scenarios.
